ac_results.evidence: Needs the loop wired to log negrisk_scan rows, signed confirmations and calendar time. The gate is CLOSED today, as expected.

defects.description: basket() passes caller rows straight to evidence() without dropping rows with ts_ms > now_ms, so future scanner rows can open the gate. Probe: 30 events of rows at NOW+10s gave basket(...) reason 'ok' at NOW. In the wired path Ledger.as_of(now) prevents this. A basket replay or backtest that passes the full scan log would have look-ahead.
defects.fix_hint: In basket(): ev = evidence([r for r in rows if r['ts_ms'] <= now_ms], params['n_min']).

defects.description: The gate and hurdle trust caller params with no floor. params n_min=0 opens the gate with zero rows (probe 7b: reason 'ok'), and a negative legging_budget lowers the hurdle (probe 9: 0.995 for raw asks summing to 1.005). This matches the spec, since these are registry parameters, but it is a soft spot in a safety gate.
defects.fix_hint: Clamp n_min to at least PREREG['n'] (30) and legging_budget to at least 0 inside basket()/hurdle(), or refuse params that violate these.

defects.description: A completion remainder below the venue min size is emitted as is (disclosed by the builder with a ponytail: comment). The router would reject it and the basket stays legged until the legging timeout.
defects.fix_hint: When wiring completion, round the remainder up to the leg min_size within the legging budget check, or unwind.

defects.description: The B5 tests give every leg the same min_size (5.0), so they cannot tell 'largest leg minimum' apart from any leg minimum. The code uses max() correctly, and my fuzz with varied min_size confirmed it.
defects.fix_hint: Add one basket case with leg min_sizes (1, 5, 15) and a size between 5 and 15, and assert it is refused.
